data.name: Search knowledge base
data.description:
Searches the Knowledge Base and returns items most relevant to the provided natural language query.
Documentation: https://developers.jasper.ai/reference/searchknowledge
Quick Start:
- Ensure {{apiKey}} is set.
- POST a JSON body with query to /v1/knowledge/search.
Parameters Explained:
- Request body (JSON):
  - query (required, string): Natural language search query to find relevant Knowledge items.
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 400 Bad Request: Missing query or malformed JSON body.
- 401/403: Missing or invalid API key.
- 500: Server error during search.
Edge Cases:
- Natural language search returns results by semantic relevance; exact keyword matches are not guaranteed.
- Very long queries may be truncated or rejected.
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- Search endpoints may have separate rate limits; consult Rate Limits documentation.
data.evaluateGuide:
Searches Jasper’s knowledge base using a natural-language query and returns relevant knowledge items.
Use for: find reusable knowledge, answer content questions, search indexed material
Not supported: adding knowledge, editing items, deleting sources

data.name: Search Knowledge Base Content

data.name: POST knowledge_base_search
data.evaluateGuide:
Provides access to monday.com’s GraphQL API for a knowledge-base search operation. The supplied details identify the API entry point but not the operation schema.
Use for: access GraphQL API, run a defined knowledge search, retrieve schema-backed data
Not supported: REST resource operations, unspecified query details, inferred field selection

data.name: Search Knowledge Base
data.description:
Search the TRIBE knowledge base for saved patterns, notes, and reusable artifacts.
Documentation: https://tribecode.ai/docs/muse
Quick Start:
- Use query parameters such as category and tags to scope your search.
- Include Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}} in the request header.
Parameters:
- category (optional): Filter by knowledge base category (e.g., pattern).
- tags (optional): Comma-separated tags to filter results (e.g., cors,bugfix).
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 401 Unauthorized: Missing/invalid API key.
- 400 Bad Request: Invalid parameter formats.
Edge Cases:
- Tag matching may be exact or partial depending on backend indexing (not documented here).
- Some knowledge items may be private and require permissions.
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- Subject to collection-level rate limits described in API Reference.
data.evaluateGuide:
Searches the TRIBE knowledge base for saved patterns, notes, and reusable artifacts, with optional category and tag filters.
Use for: find patterns, locate notes, filter reusable artifacts, search by tags
Not supported: creating artifacts, editing entries, deleting knowledge

data.name: Search Knowledge Bases
data.description:
Search knowledge bases by name or query string. Returns a list of matching knowledge bases and their document details.
Documentation: https://docs.askyourpdf.com/askyourpdf-docs
Quick Start:
- GET /v1/api/search/knowledge?query=YOUR_QUERY with x-api-key.
Parameters Explained:
- query (required, query): Search string to filter knowledge bases by name.
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 422 Validation Error: missing query parameter.
- 401 Unauthorized: invalid API key.
Edge Cases:
- Matches are returned based on name/document metadata; relevance ranking not documented.
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- Search requests count toward API usage.
data.evaluateGuide:
Searches AskYourPDF knowledge bases by name or query string and returns matching bases with document details.
Use for: find a knowledge base, match document metadata, search by name
Not supported: reading document content, uploading documents, changing knowledge bases

data.name: Search Knowledge Bases
data.description:
Search knowledge bases by name using a query string.
Documentation: https://docs.askyourpdf.com/askyourpdf-api-documentation
Quick Start:
- Ensure {{apiKey}} is set.
- Call GET /v1/api/search/knowledge?query={{query}}.
Parameters Explained:
- query (required, query): Search text to filter knowledge bases by name.
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 422 Validation Error: Missing query param.
Edge Cases:
- Results are name-based; partial matches may be returned depending on implementation.
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- Authentication required via x-api-key.
data.evaluateGuide:
Searches AskYourPDF knowledge bases by name using a query string and returns matching results.
Use for: find a knowledge base, search by name, locate matching bases
Not supported: reading document content, uploading documents, modifying knowledge bases
